DESPRE AUTOR

cunoaște-o pe Hannie Clark

Autoare, ilustratoare și co-creatoare a Scrisorilor cu Flori

Hannie Clark is the creator and storyteller behind Scrisorile cu Flori, an immersive letter experience that brings history and fiction to life through the beauty of the written word. With a deep love for storytelling, design, and human connection, Hannie crafts each series of letters to transport readers into another time and place—one envelope at a time. 

 

Since launching, Hannie has written and designed seven original series, with more than 3.5 million letters mailed to 140,000+ readers around the world—and counting. What began as a passion project has blossomed into a global movement, rekindling the joy of letter writing and reminding people everywhere of the power of story and human connection.

 

Today, Hannie continues to create each series alongside her husband and co-founder, Michael Clark. The two have been married for 22 years and share a deep creative partnership built on curiosity, imagination, and heart. Together they’ve built not only Scrisorile cu Flori, but a life centered on storytelling, family, and purpose.

 

At home, Hannie is a devoted mother to two wonderful children and two spirited miniature dachshunds who are never far from her side. When she’s not crafting her next story, you’ll find her surrounded by other creative projects, including, painting and stained glass.
